action: Edited plugins/pmcro-reflector/skills/reflect-and-seed/scripts/Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1 line 85: replaced 'if (-not $QueueRoot) { $QueueRoot = Join-Path (Split-Path (Split-Path $PmcroRoot -Parent) -Parent) ''.pmcro\queue'' }' (which re-parsed the raw -PmcroRoot string and hardcoded a literal ''.pmcro'' segment, only correct when -PmcroRoot was exactly the relative string '.\.pmcro') with 'if (-not $QueueRoot) { $QueueRoot = Join-Path (Split-Path (Split-Path $trailDir -Parent) -Parent) ''queue'' }', which walks up from the already-resolved, always-structurally-correct $trailDir (= <root>\trails\<guid> by construction from New-Trail.ps1, in both the -PmcroRoot+-TrailId and -TrailPath call shapes) instead of re-deriving from the raw parameter string, with no hardcoded '.pmcro' literal. The explicit -QueueRoot override path is untouched.

Verified the fix live in an isolated scratch sandbox (never touching real .pmcro/trails or .pmcro/queue) by running the full orchestrate->plan->make->check->reflect-and-seed script chain twice: Case A used an absolute custom -PmcroRoot (a scratchpad path distinct from CWD) and the queue item landed correctly at <that root>\queue\scratch-verify-a.json (confirmed also NOT at the drive-root P:\.pmcro\queue that the old bug produced). Case B reproduced the original default-relative-path usage ('.\.pmcro' with CWD pushed to a fake repo root) and the queue item still landed correctly at <fake repo>\.pmcro\queue\scratch-verify-b.json, confirming no regression. All scratch trails/queue items were deleted afterward; re-searched real .pmcro/queue and .pmcro/trails for any 'scratch-verify' or 'scratch' artifacts and found none.
